clue.text: Gave satisfactory all-round performance as point-to pointer?

definitions.text: Gave satisfactory all-round performance as point-to pointer?

parts.words: Gave satisfactory all-round performance as point-to pointer?
parts.note: a 'point-to-pointer' is read not as a horse in a country race but as someone reciting one compass point after another, all the way round

explanation.surface: A horse in a point-to-point race ran well all round the course.
explanation.walkthrough: A point-to-point is a British amateur steeplechase; here the phrase means naming every point of the compass in turn, which is what the answer's idiom means.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means reciting all thirty-two points in order, a complete circuit of the card.

clue.text: Where patient may be confined with foul plague

parts.note: a sick person is often confined to bed
evil means foul or wicked

explanation.surface: A hospital patient isolated because of a nasty disease.
explanation.definitionFit: To torment or harass persistently is a verb sense of plague.

clue.text: Harmless gas that gets nobody cross, upset

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the run of words before it is read backwards

parts.note: none means nobody
X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: A benign gas that makes nobody angry.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an inert noble gas that reacts with almost nothing.

clue.text: Drug jab — Capone is after it

indicators.note: 'after' places the gangster's name and the word is following the word it

parts.note: a dig is a poke or jab
taken as written
Al Capone was the Chicago gangster
taken as written

explanation.surface: Al Capone wants a shot of a narcotic.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a heart medicine made from foxglove.

clue.text: Excitement in race

definitions.meaning: a preliminary round in a competition

explanation.definitionFit: Passion is warmth of feeling, and qualifying rounds of a sprint have the same name.

clue.text: Transformed my career in agricultural business

indicators.note: transformed means changed in form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone changed their career to work in farming.
explanation.definitionFit: A dairy that makes butter and cheese is a farm enterprise.

clue.text: Important little woman inhabiting ruin

indicators.note: inhabiting means living inside, so the girl's name goes within the other word

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or ruin
Jo March is one of the sisters in Little Women

explanation.surface: A small woman living in a derelict building.
explanation.definitionFit: Of great significance is a synonym, as in a key issue.

clue.text: Male in army becoming sucker for the bigger guns

indicators.note: becoming signals that the male letter turns into the plant word

parts.note: taken as written
a tiller is a shoot sprouting from a plant's base, a sucker

explanation.surface: A soldier in the army is a fan of heavy weapons.
explanation.walkthrough: Change the M of ARMY to TILLER; 'sucker' is the gardener's word for a side shoot, not a dupe.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy guns and cannon collectively form this branch of weaponry.

clue.text: Piece of canvas or shot silk, say

indicators.note: shot silk has threads woven in differing colours, so these letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Some fabric, perhaps canvas or iridescent silk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shot silk' is a real fabric, so 'shot' passes as a description, but it shuffles SILK SAY.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small light sail flown above the royal on a square-rigged ship.

clue.text: Say bad things about a dire gent, possibly

indicators.note: 'possibly' suggests the letters of the phrase might be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Someone is tempted to speak ill of an unpleasant gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: To disparage someone is to speak badly of them, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Like black stuff in dock

definitions.meaning: resembling jet, the black mineral, so jet-black
a landing stage or pier where boats tie up

explanation.definitionFit: A pier is a dock structure, and something resembling jet is jet-like in colour.

clue.text: Futility of opposing it in any case

parts.note: V, short for versus, means against or opposing

indicators.note: the word 'in' sets the little word it within the letters of any, which serves as the case around it

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Resisting it is pointless whatever happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In any case' passes for 'anyway'; really 'case' describes the word that holds the other, and 'opposing' is the legal versus abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Futility and emptiness of effort are what the old sense of the word means, as in 'vanity of vanities'.

clue.text: Protection against cats and dogs

parts.note: seems to be about keeping pets away, but 'raining cats and dogs' means pouring rain, so this is a rain shield

explanation.surface: Something that keeps cats and dogs at bay.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the folding canopy carried to keep off heavy rain.

clue.text: Pub — English place where things happen

parts.note: a local is your neighbourhood pub

explanation.surface: An English pub where all the action takes place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The local' is everyday British for the pub nearest your home.
explanation.definitionFit: A setting or scene of events is a synonym for it.

clue.text: Bird a duck, we hear? A parrot, actually

parts.note: a cock is a male bird

indicators.note: we hear means the duck's name is said rather than spelled

parts.note: a teal is a small duck

explanation.surface: A bird that sounds like a duck turns out to be a parrot.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small crested Australian parrot, a cockatoo relative.

clue.text: Produce good sketches of water source

definitions.meaning: to make pictures skilfully, two words
a deep well from which water is drawn up by bucket and rope

explanation.definitionFit: Sketching skilfully is drawing ably, and a well with a windlass is one water is drawn from.

clue.text: A line of terrain with flowers either side is a landmark

definitions.text: A line of terrain with flowers either side
definitions.meaning: a ridge dividing two drainage basins, with rivers ('flowers') running off each side
a turning point or milestone in history

explanation.definitionFit: A divide between river basins, and figuratively a decisive turning point.

clue.text: A fish heading north, skirting small island

indicators.note: skirting means running around the edge, so the reversed letters surround the next word
in a down clue heading north means moving upwards, so these letters are read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
cod is a fish
mini means small

explanation.surface: A fish swims northwards around a little island.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a Caribbean island nation in the Lesser Antilles.

clue.text: What you may find up your tree — an ape, originally?

definitions.text: What you may find up your tree — an ape, originally?

parts.words: What you may find up your tree — an ape, originally?
parts.note: the tree is a family tree, and going far enough back up it, evolution suggests an ape-like forebear

explanation.surface: Looking up a tree and finding an ape there.
explanation.definitionFit: A forebear appears higher up a family tree, and evolution traces human forebears back to apes.

clue.text: PM a person of little significance? That's hard

parts.note: taken as written
a squit is British slang for an insignificant person
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A prime minister dismissed as a nobody finds it tough.
explanation.walkthrough: H. H. Asquith was British Prime Minister 1908-16.
explanation.definitionFit: He was a Liberal Prime Minister of Britain.

clue.text: Philosopher on the street who's reluctant to leave?

indicators.note: 'on' means set against or following, so the philosopher comes after the street abbreviation

parts.note: A. J. Ayer was a British philosopher of logical positivism

explanation.surface: A thinker out on the street who won't go home.
explanation.definitionFit: One who lingers or remains is a sticker, someone who stays on rather than departing.

clue.text: Gives new part to versatile actress

indicators.note: versatile means adaptable, so the word's letters can take another form

explanation.surface: A versatile actress is handed a fresh role.
explanation.definitionFit: Assigning a different role to an actor is the theatre meaning.

clue.text: Question and answer sequence in verse

parts.note: a train of thought or events is a sequence

explanation.surface: A question-and-answer exchange set out in poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-line stanza is a particular form of verse.

clue.text: Austrian psychologist in German state

definitions.meaning: the German word for empire, as in the Third

explanation.definitionFit: Wilhelm Reich was a Freudian analyst, and the German empire was so named.

clue.text: Like number system replacing abaci? That's about right

indicators.note: 'about' signals the letters are turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: The numeral system that took over from counting frames is roughly correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Replacing abaci' describes the numerals that superseded counting frames; then 'about' rearranges ABACI with R.
explanation.definitionFit: Our everyday digits 0 to 9 are the numerals of that system, so the adjective describes it.

clue.text: Black mud in port, for example

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
ooze is soft mud

explanation.surface: Dark mud in a harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' is not a harbour but the fortified wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Port is a fortified wine, an example of alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Singing without words? Get away!

definitions.meaning: a command to shoo someone off

explanation.definitionFit: Jazz vocal improvisation with nonsense syllables, and a dismissive 'shoo!'.

clue.text: Warlike people in city area one repulsed

indicators.note: repulsed means driven back, so the whole run is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
EC is the postcode for the City of London
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Fighting folk in an urban district push back one intruder.
explanation.walkthrough: The run INECI read backwards gives the tribe of Boudicca, who fought the Romans in ancient Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: The tribe was a fierce ancient British people who revolted against Rome.

clue.text: Conniving old emperor jeers

parts.note: the Inca was the ruler of the old Peruvian empire
hoots are jeers of derision

explanation.surface: A scheming ancient ruler is booed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in secret partnership is conspiring together, colluding.

clue.text: Dinner's produced with such lack of enthusiasm for diner

definitions.text: Dinner's produced with such lack of enthusiasm for diner

parts.words: Dinner's produced with such lack of enthusiasm for diner
parts.note: take the double N at the heart of the word dinner and keep only half of it, and the word for someone eating results

explanation.surface: A meal served so grudgingly that the guest is unimpressed.
explanation.walkthrough: The cryptic half reads the answer literally: halve the heart of DINNER and you get DINER.
explanation.definitionFit: A lack of enthusiasm is a lukewarm, unwilling attitude.
